title: Change or cancel a heavy vehicle inspection booking
summary: You can change or cancel your heavy vehicle inspection booking online, by phone, or at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you need to change or cancel your heavy vehicle inspection booking, you can do this online, by phone or at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: The inspection must be carried out in the 3-month period prior to the renewal date, otherwise your registration may be suspended or cancelled. The results of an inspection are valid for 3 months only, so factor this in when changing or cancelling your booking.
what_you_need: Your booking ID or NSW plate number

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Change or cancel online' button.
Enter your details to retrieve the booking.

more_info.text: A heavy vehicle inspection is conducted annually on heavy vehicles registered in NSW (some exemptions apply).

Usually an inspection is carried out as part of the registration renewal process. If this is the case, you'll receive a renewal notification with the date your registration renewal must be completed by.
Bookings must be made at least 24 hours prior to inspection.

faqs.q: How far in advance must I get my inspection?
faqs.a: The inspection must be carried out in the 3-month period prior to the renewal date. Otherwise, your registration may be suspended or cancelled.

faqs.q: How long are the inspection results valid for?
faqs.a: The results of an inspection are valid for 3 months only.

faqs.q: How do I change or cancel my booking?
faqs.a: You can change or cancel your booking by selecting the 'Change or cancel online' button, choosing 'Existing booking', and entering your details to retrieve and modify the booking.
